details.description:
Phool Luxury Agarbatti is handcrafted using flowers collected fresh from temple offerings across India — flowers that would otherwise be discarded into rivers.
Each stick is 100% charcoal-free, made with pure flower powder, a natural wood base, and cold-pressed fragrant oils. Unlike conventional agarbatti that releases toxic smoke from charcoal and synthetic binders, Phool Agarbatti burns cleanly, filling your home with a pure, long-lasting fragrance that honours both your space and the environment.
Available in fragrances such as Citronella, Jasmine, and Indian Rose, each scent is a gentle tribute to the sacred flowers from which it is created.
details.usageInstructions:
Place the agarbatti securely in a holder.
Light the tip of the stick using a match or lighter.
Hold the flame for 5–10 seconds, then gently blow it out — the tip should glow orange.
Allow the fragrant smoke to fill the space naturally.
Never leave a burning agarbatti unattended. Keep it away from children and flammable materials.
Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight to preserve the fragrance.

details.description:
Phool Bamboo-Free Agarbatti represents a refined step beyond conventional incense — thoughtfully crafted without a bamboo core, without charcoal, and without synthetic fragrance.
Made from upcycled temple flowers blended with natural binding powders and pure fragrant oils, each stick is fully self-sustaining, designed to hold its shape and burn evenly from tip to end. This ensures a clean burning experience with no woody residue, no splatter, and no black smoke.
The result is a pure and conscious aromatic experience that reflects both sustainability and craftsmanship. Available in elegant fragrances such as Sandalwood, Indian Rose, and Oudh, each scent is rich, natural, and long-lasting.
Ideal for daily pooja, meditation, yoga, or simply creating a serene and uplifting home atmosphere, it offers a truly clean and mindful incense experience.
details.usageInstructions:
Place the bamboo-free agarbatti securely in a suitable incense holder.
Light one end using a match or lighter and allow the flame to burn for 8–10 seconds.
Gently blow out the flame; the glowing tip should release a steady stream of fragrant smoke.
Position the holder on a stable, flat, and heat-resistant surface.
Never leave the burning incense unattended. Keep away from flammable materials, children, and pets.
Store the pack sealed in a cool, dry place to help preserve the natural fragrance oils.

details.description:
Phool Badrinath Kesar Chandan Incense Sticks carry the blessings of Lord Vishnu literally. Each stick is handcrafted from the sacred flowers offered at the Badrinath Temple, one of the holiest abodes of the Char Dham Yatra, nestled at 10,170 feet in the Himalayas.
The fragrance is a divine confluence of Kesar (saffron) and Chandan (sandalwood) two of the most auspicious elements of Hindu ritual yielding a deep, woody, and creamy aroma that brings an unmistakable sense of peace to your home. Light one during your morning or evening prayers, offer your devotion to Lord Vishnu, and invite the spiritual energy of Badrinath into your sacred space.
Flowercycled. Charcoal-free. Hand-rolled with care

details.description:
Phool Temple Series Dhoop is inspired by India’s most sacred pilgrimage sites — Kashi Vishwanath, Badrinath, Kedarnath, and Ayodhya. Each cone is crafted using flowers offered at these revered temples, which are carefully collected, dried, and transformed into fragrant dhoop.
The result is a deeply spiritual fragrance experience that brings the essence of these holy spaces into your home, enriching moments of prayer, meditation, and quiet reflection.
Completely charcoal-free and chemical-free, these dhoop cones burn cleanly without releasing harmful smoke, ensuring a pure and mindful aromatic experience.
Available in traditional fragrances such as Sandalwood, Kesar Chandan, and Gulab, each scent reflects divine association, now sustainably created from real temple flowers.
details.usageInstructions:
Place the dhoop cone on a heat-resistant surface or in a suitable holder.
Light the tip of the cone using a match or lighter.
Allow the flame to burn for 5–8 seconds, then gently blow it out — the cone should glow and release fragrant smoke.
Place it in a well-ventilated area for optimal fragrance diffusion.
Never leave burning dhoop unattended. Keep out of reach of children and away from flammable materials.
Store in the original packaging in a cool, dry place to preserve fragrance potency.

details.description: Phool Natural Mosquito Repellent Body Spray is a plant-based, DEET-free solution formulated for direct application on the skin, offering safe and effective protection without harmful chemicals. Made with pure citronella oil and natural botanical extracts, it helps repel mosquitoes while leaving a pleasant, fresh fragrance. Dermatologically tested and suitable for daily use, it serves as a gentle, natural alternative to conventional chemical repellents that may irritate sensitive skin.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake the bottle well before use.
Hold 10–15 cm away from the skin and spray onto exposed areas such as arms, legs, and neck.
Avoid contact with eyes and mucous membranes. Do not apply to broken or irritated skin.
Reapply every 3–4 hours when outdoors. Wash off with water after use.

details.description: Phool Natural Mosquito Repellent Sprays are plant-based, DEET-free alternatives to conventional chemical repellents, formulated with pure citronella oil, natural extracts, and skin-safe botanical ingredients. The room spray is designed to create a mosquito-free indoor environment, while the body spray is dermatologically tested and safe for direct application on the skin. Unlike aerosol repellents that rely on harsh synthetic chemicals, Phool’s formulations work through the natural repelling properties of citronella, a fragrance also featured in Phool’s popular incense range. Safe for the whole family, pleasant in fragrance, and effective without toxins, this repellent offers protection that is gentle on your home while remaining tough on mosquitoes.
details.usageInstructions:
Shake the bottle gently before use.
Hold upright and spray 3–4 pumps into the centre of the room, aiming upwards at a 45° angle.
Keep windows closed for 5 minutes after spraying for best results, then ventilate as desired.
Reapply every 4–6 hours or as needed; safe for use around children and pets.
